purpose: fresh-seed validation of the fixed-PDC contract for corr40-split-v3 with the per-event SNR rule (event SNR >= 10 dB), registered before any result on these seeds is seen
engine_source_commit: 549e475 (engine headers, TransposeProbe.cpp, Source/PolyPitch.h and Source/GlobalDSP.h unchanged since)
L_choice: kept at 2.5 ms (the value the research plug-in reports). With the SNR rule on all earlier seeds (known 8139/20261024 + long 1, and 26457/31623/36056 + long 2236), the largest |attack residual| over the three rates is 3.083 ms at both L = 2.5 and L = 2.75 ms; the tie keeps the implemented value
metric: per-event added delay of the 1-8 kHz 2 ms RMS attack peak (output minus input); counted only if (a) T1 whole-input validity holds (the input's own attack peaks all lie within 10 ms of their events) and (b) the event SNR is >= 10 dB (attack_snr.py: peak of the 1-8 kHz 2 ms RMS envelope within 10 ms after the event over its maximum 20-3 ms before the event); residual = added delay - L

pass_rule.primary_pdc: max |attack residual| <= 4.5 ms at each of 44.1/48/96 kHz (earlier-seed maximum 3.083 ms + 1.0 ms, rounded up to 0.5 ms; same threshold as the 2026-10-25 run)
pass_rule.secondary_t1: latency_targets.py with --event-snr-min 10: T1 (attack peak lag <= 10 ms) passes; T2-T5 verdicts reported against the unchanged spec
pass_rule.report_only: the same data without the SNR rule (default metric), residuals at L = 2.75 ms, number of events excluded by the SNR rule per rate and input kind, attack residual p5/p95, low-band onset residual (not compensated by L)

rules: single run; no change to L, metric, SNR threshold, residual threshold or inputs after seeing results
product Source/ and engine code unchanged
